paragraphs.text: Synthesis: Connect viewpoints to develop a new insight or recommendation.

paragraphs.text: Remember: Summary captures what the group developed. Synthesis advances its thinking.

paragraphs.text: LISTEN for ideas and concerns. CONNECT viewpoints. CREDIT contributors. ADVANCE an insight, compromise, or recommendation.
Try: “Building on [name]'s idea and [name]'s concern…” · “If we combine those perspectives…” · “One way to address both concerns might be…”

paragraphs.text: Organize by theme, not speaking order. Include barriers, important evidence and proposals, agreed recommendations, unresolved concerns, and credit for substantive contributions.

paragraphs.text: Try: “Our group identified three major considerations…” · “We agreed to recommend…” · “One concern that remains unresolved is…”

paragraphs.text: Do not confuse majority support with unanimity. Identify remaining concerns, explore revisions, and confirm whether the revised outcome is supportable.

paragraphs.text: Gather belongings and leave promptly. Thank the judge briefly if appropriate. Do not request rankings or prolonged feedback. Consult your coach about unexpected procedural issues. Speak respectfully with fellow competitors afterward.
